reflections.birthDate.title: Make it personal
reflections.birthDate.message: Set your birth date for Life reflections based on your own timeline.
reflections.day.quiet.title: Today is still yours
reflections.day.quiet.message: Most of today has passed. Pick one small action you’ll be glad you did.
reflections.day.radical.title: Use what’s left
reflections.day.radical.message: Most of today is gone. Finish one thing before the day ends.
reflections.month.quiet.title: This month is moving
reflections.month.quiet.message: More of this month is gone. Return to what matters before it fades into the background.
reflections.month.radical.title: The month won’t wait
reflections.month.radical.message: This month moves whether you act or not. Pick the work that matters.
reflections.year.quiet.title: A year in motion
reflections.year.quiet.message: This year is taking shape. Make one choice today your future self will notice.
reflections.year.radical.title: Shape the year
reflections.year.radical.message: The year isn’t paused. Put energy into one move that changes its direction.
reflections.life.quiet.title: Life in view
reflections.life.quiet.message: Your life is finite, and today is part of it. Give one ordinary moment full attention.
reflections.life.radical.title: Remember the horizon
reflections.life.radical.message: Your life has a horizon. Don’t spend today on autopilot. Choose on purpose.
reflections.weekly.quiet.title: Week in review
reflections.weekly.quiet.message: Seven days passed whether you noticed or not. Name one moment worth repeating.
reflections.weekly.radical.title: Don’t waste another week
reflections.weekly.radical.message: Another week is gone. Stop treating Mondays as reset buttons. Change one pattern now.
